title: Hermes UI widget catalog index
description: DRAFT — not final. The authoritative shape will be settled by hermes-ui#120 (manifest standard) and hermes-ui#121 (catalog fetch/validate). This file exists so the repo has a concrete starting point to react to, not as a frozen contract.

catalog_version.description: Version of this index format itself (not of any widget).

catalogEntry.description: One widget's identity and where to fetch it, mirroring its widget.json so the catalog can be listed without fetching every widget's repo on every page load.

version.description: Semver, must match the listed release's widget.json.

repo.description: owner/repo on GitHub this widget's code lives in.

ref.description: A pinned release tag — never a branch or HEAD.

device_classes.description: DeviceClass values this widget's device picker is scoped to, per hermes-ui's docs/smart-home/ARCHITECTURE.md §8.

sdk.description: Widget-SDK compatibility range this was built against (hermes-ui#119).
